15 July 2026 Final report published
20 March 2026 Launch of market study

Government’s response to our recommendations

13 October 2026: The UK government has today accepted all our recommendations to help improve the market for consumers. Together, they’ll help ensure consumers receive fair treatment, clear information and can take action when things go wrong.

This is an important step towards better protecting the 1.5 million people who rely on heating oil to warm their homes.

We look forward to continuing to work with governments across the UK to help deliver lasting improvements for heating oil customers wherever they live.

Final report

15 July 2026: The CMA has published the final report in its market study into the retail supply of heating oil for domestic use in the UK. The report sets out our findings and recommendations for driving better outcomes for consumers who rely on home heating oil.

  • Foreword and executive summary (PDF, 327KB) (15.7.26)
  • Final report (PDF, 3.6MB) (15.7.26)
  • Press release: UK’s heating oil households need stronger protections, says CMA  (15.7.26)

Launch of market study

20 March 2026: The CMA launched a market study into the retail supply of heating oil for domestic use in the UK.

We invite views by 8 April 2026 from all interested parties on the areas covered in the Statement of Scope.

We aim to complete the market study and publish our final report within 3 months of launch.

  • Market study notice (PDF, 101KB) (20.3.26)

Privacy notice

The CMA may collect, use and share personal data for its market studies under the Enterprise Act 2002. This includes processing personal data for the purposes of the UK General Data Protection Regulation and the Data Protection Act 2018. 

For more information about how the CMA handles personal data, visit the CMA’s personal information charter.
